# UDPStreamIP

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

```blitzbasic
UDPStreamIP udp_stream%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | Int | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address of this computer that the stream receives on.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* It is the first address of this computer that [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs) finds with an empty name, one that other computers can reach if there is any. See [Differences](Differences#network-addresses).
